changes.reason: The orchard now authors two persistent resolutions, a bounded family rescue objective, visible consequence dialogue and a Rowan callback after reload.
The pack hash covers the new map data and objective completion also records a map-scoped event for authored post-battle continuity.

Move Mara’s opening clue trigger into her normal interaction area so the mystery starts when the player speaks to her; keep the Verdant Seal prerequisite and check the interaction coverage in regression tests.
Make the press clue actionable by naming the reachable damp hollow and allow repeat inspection to recall the clue without repeating its one-time event.
